title: The Last Oath Revisited
author: E. M. Thackeray
blurb: Silas Blackwood, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then the border wards fall on the same night the stars go out — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
